41: --- initialize artifice tools, update mastery level and unlearn any unselected tools talents
42: function artifice_tools_setup(self, t)
43: 	self.artifice_tools = self.artifice_tools or {}
44: 	self:setTalentTypeMastery("cunning/tools", self:getTalentMastery(t))
45: 	for tid, m_tid in pairs(artifice_tool_tids) do
46: 		if self:knowTalent(tid) then
47: 			local slot
48: 			for slot_id, tool_id in pairs(self.artifice_tools) do
49: 				if tool_id == tid then slot = slot_id break end
50: 			end
51: 			if not slot then self:unlearnTalentFull(tid) end
52: 		end
53: 		if self.artifice_tools_mastery == tid then
54: 			local m_level = self:getTalentLevelRaw(self.T_MASTER_ARTIFICER)
55: 			if self:getTalentLevelRaw(m_tid) ~= m_level then
56: 				self:unlearnTalentFull(m_tid)
57: 				self:learnTalent(m_tid, true, m_level, {no_unlearn=true})
58: 			end
59: 		elseif self:knowTalent(m_tid) then
60: 			self:unlearnTalentFull(m_tid)
61: 		end
62: 	end

423: --- Describes an attribute, to expand object name
424: function _M:descAttribute(attr)

426: 		if config.settings.tome.advanced_weapon_stats then

433: 		local tms = {}

439: 		end
